result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.add_grid_2d()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Add a 2D grid/lattice graph to the current graph. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L2154-L2253){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.add_grid_2d(rows, cols, type=None, label=True, rel=None) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Creates a rectangular grid where each interior node is connected to its four neighbors (up, down, left, right). Edge nodes have fewer connections. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [rows]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Number of rows in the grid. [cols]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Number of columns in the grid. [type]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional node type/category for all nodes. [label]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[True]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True`, label nodes with their IDs. [rel]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional relationship (`rel`) label for all edges. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#7a4d6250 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph() graph.add_grid_2d(3, 4) # 3×4 grid # Returns node count graph.count_nodes() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 12 ``` ::: ::: ::: {#caa376bf .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Returns edge count: 17 (edges: 3*3 + 2*4) graph.count_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 17 ``` ::: :::
